mapper.select: SELECT d.*, u.real_name AS leader_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user x WHERE x.dept_id = d.id) AS staff_count FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.leader_id ORDER BY d.sort_no, d.id
SELECT * FROM sys_post ORDER BY sort_no
SELECT u.*, d.dept_name AS dept_name, p.post_name AS post_name ORDER BY u.dept_id, u.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT u.*, d.dept_name AS dept_name, p.post_name AS post_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sys_post p ON u.post_id = p.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, avatar, dept_id, post_id, phone, email, status, hire_date) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{avatar}, #{deptId}, #{postId}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{hireDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET real_name=#{realName}, dept_id=#{deptId}, post_id=#{postId}, phone=#{phone}, email=#{email}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dept (parent_id, dept_name, dept_code, leader_id, sort_no, status) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{deptCode}, #{leaderId}, #{sortNo}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET parent_id=#{parentId}, dept_name=#{deptName}, dept_code=#{deptCode}, leader_id=#{leaderId}, sort_no=#{sortNo}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
